name: ELAN Microelectronics Corporation
summary: ELAN Microelectronics Corporation operates as a semiconductor company in Taiwan, Mainland China, Hong Kong, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It offers embedded microcontrollers and systems, digital signal processors, computer peripheral control integrated circuits and systems, fingerprint recognition devices, and credit card applications. The company also provides biometric solutions, including biometric smart cards, pad and button modules, key cap fingerprint modules, biometric USB dongles, under display fingerprint sensors, and fingerprint sensors with coatings/cover glasses, as well as facial recognition solutions.
